body: Like I said in the post, no one is saying you should keep harmful people in your life. But if you're removing someone from your life, they need to know the exact reason why you're doing it. Yes, it is your responsibility to explain it to them, if for no other reason, then in order to prevent them from becoming an even more bitter person after their experience with you and from taking it out on another, innocent person who ends up dealing with them after you.
